subject: VertexIndex ACK: preserve direct indexed pulling; hardware base-offset exists
body:
Source-based compiler/IDVS contract review, no code edit or build. Preserve direct indexed vertex-pulling (no attributes) with instances1/baseInstance0/baseVertex0 and vertex_start0: render_encoder native indexed branch passes the original retained index BO into q.index/q.index_size; nord2_metal_render.c216 selects UINT16/UINT32 and c225 supplies a->index at job+120. The compiler emits load_vertex_id via hardware BI_PRELOAD_VERTEX_ID (bifrost_compile.c2159-2170); pinned Mesa says Valhall malloc-IDVS vertex_id is not zero-based. generic_job_ui.h85-89 explicitly documents IDs come from the indices. Therefore do NOT reject merely because drawIndexSize is nonzero. Host regression should preserve arbitrary indices e.g7,2,9 and uint16/uint32, original BO+offset, primitive.index_type, no expandedVertex. This is source/packet evidence, not new hardware pixel qualification.

Your current draft condition genericVertexIndex && (vertex_start || expandedVertex) is the appropriate containment for the EXISTING ABI. CPU attribute expansion changes invocation IDs to0..n-1 and loses original index values; pointer rebasing by vertexStart changes fetched attributes but not shader IDs. Keep explicit refusal for these cases when VertexIndex is actually live. Identity indices0..n-1 with baseVertex0 can remain plain draws. Do not globally refuse all indexed shaders.

Important correction to draft comment: Valhall hardware DOES have a base-vertex/first-vertex mechanism; the current TGJ1 REQUEST does not expose it. v9.xml Primitive field Base vertex offset is signed32 at word1; pinned gallium/drivers/panfrost/pan_jm.c740-749 sets it to draw.index_bias for indexed draws, draw.start for nonindexed. Current n2r leaves it zero. For a future/additive request sidecar, setting primitive.base_vertex_offset to actual draw start/bias and keeping attribute descriptors based at the original buffer offset (NOT already start*stride rebased) can preserve VertexIndex + attribute identity without changing compilation of VertexIndex itself. Validate full address range/negative-base underflow and avoid applying offset twice. Texture/backend owner must wire that field and render request together, defaultzero keeps old bytes. This alone does not authorize BaseVertex/FirstVertex shader builtins or instancing: those driver sysvals need separate compiler/runtime agreement; current base_instance zero specialization remains only the old contract. Test both VS attribute+VertexIndex and pure pulling at nonzero start/index bias before any support claim.
